skills.name: blocked
skills.description: Use in an Ekumen task session when you hit a choice you may not make yourself (above your task's tier grants, a contract that looks wrong, anything touching production, outward actions, releases or irreversible steps). Turns it into a decision record for the lead with `ekumen decision raise` and lets you keep working on everything else. Also use when the lead says "answer your questions", or at a natural breakpoint, to answer questions about the decisions you raised and pick up applied decisions.

skills.name: brief
skills.description: Use in an Ekumen orchestrator session when the lead asks for a brief ("write the brief for X", "turn this issue into a brief"), or when the orchestrator's inbox shows a `brief` action. Scaffolds the task with `ekumen brief new`, guides filling each section (goal, context verified against main, job, touches, definition of done, out of scope, escalation, start prompt), checks it with `ekumen brief check`, and hands it to the lead for approval. Never approves.

skills.name: decide
skills.description: Use when the lead of an Ekumen project wants to work through a pending decision, or an orchestrator session acts on the lead's explicit word. Picks a decision from the lead's inbox (or takes an id), shows it with its background, answers follow-up questions from the record or routes them to the session that raised it without derailing that session, records the lead's answer, and applies it so the blocked work can move.
